Uang pesangon (severance pay)
authority: PP 35/2021 art.40(2) with arts.42–57: one month’s wages under a year of service rising to nine at eight years or more, at the multiple the ground of termination states — one for redundancy without losses (art.43), 1.75 for retirement (art.56), two for death (art.57). Wages are the basic plus the fixed allowances (art.40(4)). Applied 2026-09-19 (2): PP 35/2021 art.52(1): a termination for a violation after warnings (DISMISSAL) carries half the art.40(2) pesangon; art.56 retirement 1.75×; art.57 death 2×; redundancy under art.43–44 the whole (efficiency to avert loss, art.43(1)(a): 0.5× — not distinguished by the exit reasons).

bands.amount: round_unit(person.terms.monthly_wage * (person.employment.service_months < 12 ? 1.0 : person.employment.service_months < 24 ? 2.0 : person.employment.service_months < 36 ? 3.0 : person.employment.service_months < 48 ? 4.0 : person.employment.service_months < 60 ? 5.0 : person.employment.service_months < 72 ? 6.0 : person.employment.service_months < 84 ? 7.0 : person.employment.service_months < 96 ? 8.0 : 9.0) * (person.employment.exit_reason == "DEATH" ? 2.0 : person.employment.exit_reason == "RETIREMENT" ? 1.75 : person.employment.exit_reason in ["DISMISSAL", "RETRENCHMENT"] ? 0.5 : 1.0))

name: Uang penghargaan masa kerja (service award)
authority: PP 35/2021 art.40(3): two months’ wages at three years of service, three at six, four at nine, five at twelve, six at fifteen, seven at eighteen, eight at twenty-one and ten at twenty-four or more, at the same grounds as the severance pay. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): PP 35/2021 art.52(1): the service award is paid whole on a dismissal after warnings.

bands.amount: round_unit(person.terms.monthly_wage * (person.employment.service_months < 36 ? 0.0 : person.employment.service_months < 72 ? 2.0 : person.employment.service_months < 108 ? 3.0 : person.employment.service_months < 144 ? 4.0 : person.employment.service_months < 180 ? 5.0 : person.employment.service_months < 216 ? 6.0 : person.employment.service_months < 252 ? 7.0 : person.employment.service_months < 288 ? 8.0 : 10.0))

name: Uang kompensasi PKWT (fixed-term compensation)
authority: PP 35/2021 art.15–16: a fixed-term worker of at least a month’s service is paid one month’s wages for every twelve months, pro rata, when the term ends. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): PP 35/2021 art.15(1): compensation at the end of a fixed-term contract; art.17: where either party ends it before its term, compensation for the period served; art.15(5): a foreign worker on a fixed term is outside it.
